title: E-FRC-0292: explores whether the husk light's own quantum sector, with the R* member coupled by its Peierls shift...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0292 in the quantum arena: explores whether the husk light's own quantum sector, with the R* member coupled by its Peierls shift, is a massless isotropic photon with Planck's spectrum and a Casimir force, on the largest slice an engine holds: the light's exact quadratic sector on the whole husk; the compact sector (about $N^{8V}$ states) is out of reach, so the whole-husk verdict stays open.
